About this tab

What Indexing Does

Indexing reads a project's source files and stores them as searchable vectors, keyword entries, and code symbols, so massa-ai's memory and search tools can find relevant code and context. Re-index after large changes to keep that view current.

Index Project

Project Path
Absolute path to the project directory to index. Must be a git repository or a directory with source files.
Project ID (optional)
Unique identifier for the project. Defaults to the directory basename. Used to scope all indexed data (memories, search, symbols).
Force Reindex
When checked, re-indexes all files even if they have not changed since the last index. Use after changing embedding models or when the index is corrupted.
Warm Cache
When checked, pre-warms the search cache after indexing. Speeds up the first search query but adds time to the indexing process.

What Delete Removes

Delete removes a project's indexed vectors, keyword entries, symbols, and memories, irreversibly. The project's files on disk are untouched — only massa-ai's record of it disappears from this list.

Embedding Dimension Note

If a project is missing from the list, the current embedding model's dimension may not match the dimension used when the project was indexed. Check the Embedding section in Config for the correct dimensions value, or reindex the project.

Config

About this tab

How Config Saves

Each section below saves independently — editing a field and pressing that section's Save button writes only that section, leaving every other section untouched.

Sections That Require A Restart

A section badged as requiring one takes effect only after the massa-ai server process restarts; saving it does not change the behavior of the already-running process.

Each section's own "Field guide" toggle explains its individual fields, defaults, and examples.

Database restart needed

Field guide
Database URL
PostgreSQL connection string (e.g., postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db). Changing this requires a server restart.

Embedding

Field guide
Provider
Which embedding provider to use. Ollama runs locally; others are cloud APIs.
Model
The embedding model name (e.g., qwen3-embedding:4b for Ollama).
Base URL
Base URL for the embedding API. For Ollama, typically http://localhost:11434.
API Key
API key for cloud providers. Not needed for Ollama. Changing this requires a restart.
Dimensions
Embedding vector dimension. Must match the model's output dimension (e.g., 2560 for qwen3-embedding:4b).

Compression

Field guide
Default Strategy
Compression strategy: code_structure, conversation_summary, semantic_dedup, or hierarchical.
Min Tokens
Minimum token count to trigger compression. Below this, content is kept verbatim.
Target Ratio (0-1)
Target compression ratio (0.7 = reduce to 70% of original).
Prompt (optional)
Custom LLM prompt for compression. When empty, uses the built-in default.

Impact Analysis

Field guide
BFS CTE Enabled
When checked, impact analysis uses a PostgreSQL recursive CTE for BFS traversal. Faster on large graphs but requires PostgreSQL 17+.

Capture Policy

Not configured — using built-in defaults (DEFAULT_POLICY from the capture-policy pure module)
Field guide
Max Match Work
Maximum glob match operations before bailing. Default: 100000.
Max Ignore Patterns
Maximum ignore patterns allowed. Default: 1024.
Rules (JSON)
Capture rules as JSON array of {pattern, disposition: Keep|Drop|MetadataOnly}. When absent, the built-in DEFAULT_POLICY applies.

Cache

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables the two-level cache (L1 in-memory, L2 disk).
L1 Max Size (MB)
Maximum L1 (in-memory) cache size in megabytes.
L2 Max Size (MB)
Maximum L2 (disk) cache size in megabytes.
Default TTL (s)
Default time-to-live for cache entries in seconds.

Data Directory

Field guide
Data Directory
Base directory for massa-ai data files (checkpoints, exports, etc.).

Logging

Field guide
Level
Log verbosity level. debug is most verbose; error is least.
Enable Metrics
When checked, emits structured metrics events for monitoring.
Log File (optional)
Path to a log file. When empty, logs go to stdout only.

Search

Field guide
Auto Reindex Max Files
Maximum file count to auto-reindex without prompting. Above this, manual reindex is required.
Query Understanding Enabled
When checked, rewrites user queries using LLM for better retrieval.
HyDE Enabled
When checked, generates hypothetical document embeddings (HyDE) to improve query matching.
QU Cache TTL (ms)
Time-to-live for query understanding cache entries in milliseconds.
QU Cache Max Size
Maximum number of cached query understanding results.
Rerank Enabled
When checked, applies a reranker to search results for improved relevance.
Rerank Window
Number of top results to consider for reranking.

LLM

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables LLM-powered features (consolidation, query understanding, compression).
Base URL
Base URL for the LLM API (e.g., http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
API Key
API key for the LLM provider. Not needed for local Ollama. Changing this requires a restart.
Model
Primary LLM model name (e.g., qwen2.5:7b-instruct).
Code Model
Model used for code-related tasks. When empty, falls back to the primary model.
Temperature
Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative). Typically 0.2 for tasks.
Max Output Tokens
Maximum tokens the LLM can generate in a single response.
Timeout (ms)
Request timeout in milliseconds. Increase for slow models.
Disable Think
When checked, disables thinking/reasoning mode in models that support it (faster, cheaper).

Memory

Field guide
Decay Lambda
Exponential decay rate for memory importance over time.
Decay Sigma
Decay bandwidth — controls how quickly memories lose relevance.
Decay Mu
Decay midpoint — the time at which importance is halved.
Decay Cold Threshold
Importance score below which a memory is considered 'cold' and eligible for consolidation.
Bootstrap Enabled
When checked, seeds initial memories from the repo on first use.
Bootstrap Max Seeds
Maximum number of memories to seed during bootstrap.
Bootstrap Centrality Limit
Number of top central files to include in bootstrap.
Bootstrap Git Log Limit
Number of recent git commits to analyze during bootstrap.
Bootstrap Refresh
When checked, periodically re-runs bootstrap to capture new repo changes.
Auto Improve Enabled
When checked, the auto-improvement loop detects patterns and proposes memory optimizations.
Auto Improve Review Gate
When checked, auto-improvement proposals require human review before applying. When unchecked, eligible proposals auto-apply.
Auto Improve Min Observations
Minimum observations required before a pattern is proposed.
Auto Improve Min Interval (ms)
Minimum time between auto-improvement runs in milliseconds.
Auto Improve Max Window
Maximum number of recent observations to consider per run.
Auto Improve Min Query Hits
Minimum repeated query hits to trigger a pattern proposal.
Auto Improve Min File Hits
Minimum repeated file access hits to trigger a proposal.
Auto Improve Min Fix Hits
Minimum repeated fix patterns to trigger a proposal.
Auto Importance Enabled
When checked, automatically scores memory importance based on access patterns.

Hooks

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables passive lifecycle hook capture (session start/end, tool use events).
Max Payload Bytes
Maximum payload size for hook events. Larger payloads are truncated.
Queue Max Pending
Maximum pending hook events in the processing queue.
Bridge Enabled
When checked, bridges captured observations into durable memories via consolidation.
Bridge Min Observations
Minimum observations required before a bridge consolidation runs.
Bridge Min Interval (ms)
Minimum time between bridge consolidation runs in milliseconds.
Bridge Max Window
Maximum number of observations to consider per bridge run.

Synapse

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables the Synapse cognitive modulation layer (task alignment, working memory, inhibition).
Diversity Penalty
When checked, penalizes search results that are too similar to already-seen items.
DP Threshold
Similarity threshold above which the diversity penalty applies.
DP Lambda
Strength of the diversity penalty.
Temporal Inhibition
When checked, suppresses recently-seen items from appearing again too soon.
TI Penalty Age (ms)
Time window in milliseconds during which a recently-seen item is penalized.
TI Penalty
Penalty score applied to recently-seen items.
Confidence Gate
When checked, filters search results by confidence thresholds.
CG Specific
Confidence threshold for specific (high-relevance) results.
CG Focused
Confidence threshold for focused (medium-relevance) results.
CG Broad
Confidence threshold for broad (low-relevance) results.
Attention Scoring
When checked, applies attention-based scoring (recency, semantic, task alignment) to search results.
Attention Rerank Window
Number of top results to rerank using attention scoring.
Recency Half Life (ms)
Half-life for recency decay in attention scoring.
Semantic Scale
Scaling factor for the semantic similarity component in attention scoring.
Metacognition
When checked, enables metacognitive monitoring (confidence assessment of search results).
Low Confidence Threshold
Score below which a result is flagged as low-confidence.
Definitive Top Score
Score above which a result is considered definitively relevant.
Definitive Gap
Minimum gap between top and second result to declare a definitive match.
Buffer Enabled
When checked, enables the working-memory buffer for cross-search continuity.
Buffer Max Size
Maximum number of entries in the working-memory buffer.
Buffer TTL (ms)
Time-to-live for working-memory buffer entries in milliseconds.
Buffer Hit Boost
Score boost applied to results that hit the working-memory buffer.
Buffer Match Threshold
Similarity threshold for a buffer hit.

Handoffs

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables cross-session handoffs (structured summaries left for a later agent to discover).

Security restart needed

Field guide
API Key
API key required on every request except /health, /swagger, and /ui. Auto-provisioned on first start. Changing this requires a restart.
CORS Origins
Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Empty means no CORS.
Allowed Extensions
Comma-separated list of file extensions allowed for indexing.

Scheduler

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables the background job scheduler (memory-consolidation, decay-sweep, auto-improve, observation-bridge, checkpoint-purge).
Tick Interval (ms)
How often the scheduler checks whether a job is due to run, in milliseconds. Minimum 1000.
Max Concurrent Jobs
Maximum number of scheduled jobs allowed to run at the same time. Minimum 1.
Memory Consolidation Enabled
When checked, the memory-consolidation job runs on its own schedule.
Memory Consolidation Interval (ms)
Interval between memory-consolidation runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
Decay Sweep Enabled
When checked, the decay-sweep job runs on its own schedule.
Decay Sweep Interval (ms)
Interval between decay-sweep runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
Auto Improve Enabled
When checked, the auto-improve job runs on its own schedule.
Auto Improve Interval (ms)
Interval between auto-improve runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
Observation Bridge Enabled
When checked, the observation-bridge job runs on its own schedule.
Observation Bridge Interval (ms)
Interval between observation-bridge runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
Checkpoint Purge Enabled
When checked, the checkpoint-purge job runs on its own schedule.
Checkpoint Purge Interval (ms)
Interval between checkpoint-purge runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.

About this tab

What A Profile Is

A profile is a named bundle of model choices — one model and effort setting per tool (Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) and per capability tier. Switching a tool to a different profile changes which model every agent on that tool runs.

Capability Tiers

Light, Standard, and Deep are the three capability tiers a profile assigns a model to, from fastest/cheapest to most capable. An agent runs whichever tier its charter — or your Per-Agent Tier Override below — names.

Managing Profiles

Add Profile
Creates a new profile with a name you choose. The new profile starts with empty model/effort cells for every tool and tier.
Duplicate Profile
Copies an existing profile (you choose which) to a new name. Useful for creating a variant of an existing profile without re-entering all cells.
Delete Profile
Removes a profile. If it is one of the built-in profiles, it moves to the Removed Profiles list below (restorable). If you added it yourself, it is removed entirely.

Default Profile per Tool

Default Profile per Tool
The declared default profile per tool, used only the first time that tool is auto-installed (it has no recorded active profile yet). It is not the profile currently installed on this machine — a tool can be running any profile you switched it to, regardless of what Default Profile per Tool reads here. See the "Active Profile" tab to view each tool's actual active profile and to change it.

Per-Workflow Tier Overrides

Maps a workflow name to a tier, overriding the charter default for agents dispatched under that workflow. Add one (e.g., spec-driven → deep) to pin a heavier model tier for a specific workflow.

Per-Agent Tier Overrides

Maps one agent to a tier, per tool — the only way to run, for example, builder at Deep on OpenCode while it stays Standard everywhere else. Pick the (default: ...) option to remove the override and go back to inheriting the agent's charter tier.

Save & Apply

Persists every unsaved change on this tab (profile cells, Default Profile per Tool, Per-Workflow Tier Overrides, Per-Agent Tier Overrides, add/duplicate/delete profile) to your local machine, then regenerates and installs the agent files for every tool. Asks for confirmation first. Restart your CLI sessions (Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) afterward — an already-running session keeps using the model it started with until you do.

Discard All Overrides

Deletes your saved changes, reverting every tool to the built-in defaults. Asks for confirmation. All profiles you added, cell overrides, default-profile changes, and Per-Workflow/Per-Agent overrides are lost. Removed profiles are restored.

Removed Profiles

A deleted built-in profile is not gone forever — it moves to the Removed Profiles list below, where Restore brings it back.

What A Profile Is

A profile is a named bundle of model choices — one model and effort setting per tool (Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) and per capability tier. Switching a tool to a different profile changes which model every agent on that tool runs.

Capability Tiers

Light, Standard, and Deep are the three capability tiers a profile assigns a model to, from fastest/cheapest to most capable. An agent runs whichever tier its charter — or your Per-Agent Tier Override below — names.

Managing Profiles

Add Profile
Creates a new profile with a name you choose. The new profile starts with empty model/effort cells for every tool and tier.
Duplicate Profile
Copies an existing profile (you choose which) to a new name. Useful for creating a variant of an existing profile without re-entering all cells.
Delete Profile
Removes a profile. If it is one of the built-in profiles, it moves to the Removed Profiles list below (restorable). If you added it yourself, it is removed entirely.

Default Profile per Tool

Default Profile per Tool
The declared default profile per tool, used only the first time that tool is auto-installed (it has no recorded active profile yet). It is not the profile currently installed on this machine — a tool can be running any profile you switched it to, regardless of what Default Profile per Tool reads here. See the "Active Profile" tab to view each tool's actual active profile and to change it.

Per-Workflow Tier Overrides

Maps a workflow name to a tier, overriding the charter default for agents dispatched under that workflow. Add one (e.g., spec-driven → deep) to pin a heavier model tier for a specific workflow.

Per-Agent Tier Overrides

Maps one agent to a tier, per tool — the only way to run, for example, builder at Deep on OpenCode while it stays Standard everywhere else. Pick the (default: ...) option to remove the override and go back to inheriting the agent's charter tier.

Save & Apply

Persists every unsaved change on this tab (profile cells, Default Profile per Tool, Per-Workflow Tier Overrides, Per-Agent Tier Overrides, add/duplicate/delete profile) to your local machine, then regenerates and installs the agent files for every tool. Asks for confirmation first. Restart your CLI sessions (Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) afterward — an already-running session keeps using the model it started with until you do.

Discard All Overrides

Deletes your saved changes, reverting every tool to the built-in defaults. Asks for confirmation. All profiles you added, cell overrides, default-profile changes, and Per-Workflow/Per-Agent overrides are lost. Removed profiles are restored.

Removed Profiles

A deleted built-in profile is not gone forever — it moves to the Removed Profiles list below, where Restore brings it back.

About this tab

What Indexing Does

Indexing reads a project's source files and stores them as searchable vectors, keyword entries, and code symbols, so massa-ai's memory and search tools can find relevant code and context. Re-index after large changes to keep that view current.

Index Project

Project Path
Absolute path to the project directory to index. Must be a git repository or a directory with source files.
Project ID (optional)
Unique identifier for the project. Defaults to the directory basename. Used to scope all indexed data (memories, search, symbols).
Force Reindex
When checked, re-indexes all files even if they have not changed since the last index. Use after changing embedding models or when the index is corrupted.
Warm Cache
When checked, pre-warms the search cache after indexing. Speeds up the first search query but adds time to the indexing process.

What Delete Removes

Delete removes a project's indexed vectors, keyword entries, symbols, and memories, irreversibly. The project's files on disk are untouched — only massa-ai's record of it disappears from this list.

Embedding Dimension Note

If a project is missing from the list, the current embedding model's dimension may not match the dimension used when the project was indexed. Check the Embedding section in Config for the correct dimensions value, or reindex the project.

Config

About this tab

How Config Saves

Each section below saves independently — editing a field and pressing that section's Save button writes only that section, leaving every other section untouched.

Sections That Require A Restart

A section badged as requiring one takes effect only after the massa-ai server process restarts; saving it does not change the behavior of the already-running process.

Each section's own "Field guide" toggle explains its individual fields, defaults, and examples.

Database restart needed

Field guide
Database URL
PostgreSQL connection string (e.g., postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db). Changing this requires a server restart.

Embedding

Field guide
Provider
Which embedding provider to use. Ollama runs locally; others are cloud APIs.
Model
The embedding model name (e.g., qwen3-embedding:4b for Ollama).
Base URL
Base URL for the embedding API. For Ollama, typically http://localhost:11434.
API Key
API key for cloud providers. Not needed for Ollama. Changing this requires a restart.
Dimensions
Embedding vector dimension. Must match the model's output dimension (e.g., 2560 for qwen3-embedding:4b).

Compression

Field guide
Default Strategy
Compression strategy: code_structure, conversation_summary, semantic_dedup, or hierarchical.
Min Tokens
Minimum token count to trigger compression. Below this, content is kept verbatim.
Target Ratio (0-1)
Target compression ratio (0.7 = reduce to 70% of original).
Prompt (optional)
Custom LLM prompt for compression. When empty, uses the built-in default.

Impact Analysis

Field guide
BFS CTE Enabled
When checked, impact analysis uses a PostgreSQL recursive CTE for BFS traversal. Faster on large graphs but requires PostgreSQL 17+.

Capture Policy

Not configured — using built-in defaults (DEFAULT_POLICY from the capture-policy pure module)
Field guide
Max Match Work
Maximum glob match operations before bailing. Default: 100000.
Max Ignore Patterns
Maximum ignore patterns allowed. Default: 1024.
Rules (JSON)
Capture rules as JSON array of {pattern, disposition: Keep|Drop|MetadataOnly}. When absent, the built-in DEFAULT_POLICY applies.

Cache

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables the two-level cache (L1 in-memory, L2 disk).
L1 Max Size (MB)
Maximum L1 (in-memory) cache size in megabytes.
L2 Max Size (MB)
Maximum L2 (disk) cache size in megabytes.
Default TTL (s)
Default time-to-live for cache entries in seconds.

Data Directory

Field guide
Data Directory
Base directory for massa-ai data files (checkpoints, exports, etc.).

Logging

Field guide
Level
Log verbosity level. debug is most verbose; error is least.
Enable Metrics
When checked, emits structured metrics events for monitoring.
Log File (optional)
Path to a log file. When empty, logs go to stdout only.

Search

Field guide
Auto Reindex Max Files
Maximum file count to auto-reindex without prompting. Above this, manual reindex is required.
Query Understanding Enabled
When checked, rewrites user queries using LLM for better retrieval.
HyDE Enabled
When checked, generates hypothetical document embeddings (HyDE) to improve query matching.
QU Cache TTL (ms)
Time-to-live for query understanding cache entries in milliseconds.
QU Cache Max Size
Maximum number of cached query understanding results.
Rerank Enabled
When checked, applies a reranker to search results for improved relevance.
Rerank Window
Number of top results to consider for reranking.

LLM

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables LLM-powered features (consolidation, query understanding, compression).
Base URL
Base URL for the LLM API (e.g., http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
API Key
API key for the LLM provider. Not needed for local Ollama. Changing this requires a restart.
Model
Primary LLM model name (e.g., qwen2.5:7b-instruct).
Code Model
Model used for code-related tasks. When empty, falls back to the primary model.
Temperature
Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative). Typically 0.2 for tasks.
Max Output Tokens
Maximum tokens the LLM can generate in a single response.
Timeout (ms)
Request timeout in milliseconds. Increase for slow models.
Disable Think
When checked, disables thinking/reasoning mode in models that support it (faster, cheaper).

Memory

Field guide
Decay Lambda
Exponential decay rate for memory importance over time.
Decay Sigma
Decay bandwidth — controls how quickly memories lose relevance.
Decay Mu
Decay midpoint — the time at which importance is halved.
Decay Cold Threshold
Importance score below which a memory is considered 'cold' and eligible for consolidation.
Bootstrap Enabled
When checked, seeds initial memories from the repo on first use.
Bootstrap Max Seeds
Maximum number of memories to seed during bootstrap.
Bootstrap Centrality Limit
Number of top central files to include in bootstrap.
Bootstrap Git Log Limit
Number of recent git commits to analyze during bootstrap.
Bootstrap Refresh
When checked, periodically re-runs bootstrap to capture new repo changes.
Auto Improve Enabled
When checked, the auto-improvement loop detects patterns and proposes memory optimizations.
Auto Improve Review Gate
When checked, auto-improvement proposals require human review before applying. When unchecked, eligible proposals auto-apply.
Auto Improve Min Observations
Minimum observations required before a pattern is proposed.
Auto Improve Min Interval (ms)
Minimum time between auto-improvement runs in milliseconds.
Auto Improve Max Window
Maximum number of recent observations to consider per run.
Auto Improve Min Query Hits
Minimum repeated query hits to trigger a pattern proposal.
Auto Improve Min File Hits
Minimum repeated file access hits to trigger a proposal.
Auto Improve Min Fix Hits
Minimum repeated fix patterns to trigger a proposal.
Auto Importance Enabled
When checked, automatically scores memory importance based on access patterns.

Hooks

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables passive lifecycle hook capture (session start/end, tool use events).
Max Payload Bytes
Maximum payload size for hook events. Larger payloads are truncated.
Queue Max Pending
Maximum pending hook events in the processing queue.
Bridge Enabled
When checked, bridges captured observations into durable memories via consolidation.
Bridge Min Observations
Minimum observations required before a bridge consolidation runs.
Bridge Min Interval (ms)
Minimum time between bridge consolidation runs in milliseconds.
Bridge Max Window
Maximum number of observations to consider per bridge run.

Synapse

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables the Synapse cognitive modulation layer (task alignment, working memory, inhibition).
Diversity Penalty
When checked, penalizes search results that are too similar to already-seen items.
DP Threshold
Similarity threshold above which the diversity penalty applies.
DP Lambda
Strength of the diversity penalty.
Temporal Inhibition
When checked, suppresses recently-seen items from appearing again too soon.
TI Penalty Age (ms)
Time window in milliseconds during which a recently-seen item is penalized.
TI Penalty
Penalty score applied to recently-seen items.
Confidence Gate
When checked, filters search results by confidence thresholds.
CG Specific
Confidence threshold for specific (high-relevance) results.
CG Focused
Confidence threshold for focused (medium-relevance) results.
CG Broad
Confidence threshold for broad (low-relevance) results.
Attention Scoring
When checked, applies attention-based scoring (recency, semantic, task alignment) to search results.
Attention Rerank Window
Number of top results to rerank using attention scoring.
Recency Half Life (ms)
Half-life for recency decay in attention scoring.
Semantic Scale
Scaling factor for the semantic similarity component in attention scoring.
Metacognition
When checked, enables metacognitive monitoring (confidence assessment of search results).
Low Confidence Threshold
Score below which a result is flagged as low-confidence.
Definitive Top Score
Score above which a result is considered definitively relevant.
Definitive Gap
Minimum gap between top and second result to declare a definitive match.
Buffer Enabled
When checked, enables the working-memory buffer for cross-search continuity.
Buffer Max Size
Maximum number of entries in the working-memory buffer.
Buffer TTL (ms)
Time-to-live for working-memory buffer entries in milliseconds.
Buffer Hit Boost
Score boost applied to results that hit the working-memory buffer.
Buffer Match Threshold
Similarity threshold for a buffer hit.

Handoffs

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables cross-session handoffs (structured summaries left for a later agent to discover).

Security restart needed

Field guide
API Key
API key required on every request except /health, /swagger, and /ui. Auto-provisioned on first start. Changing this requires a restart.
CORS Origins
Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Empty means no CORS.
Allowed Extensions
Comma-separated list of file extensions allowed for indexing.

Scheduler

Field guide
Enabled
When checked, enables the background job scheduler (memory-consolidation, decay-sweep, auto-improve, observation-bridge, checkpoint-purge).
Tick Interval (ms)
How often the scheduler checks whether a job is due to run, in milliseconds. Minimum 1000.
Max Concurrent Jobs
Maximum number of scheduled jobs allowed to run at the same time. Minimum 1.
Memory Consolidation Enabled
When checked, the memory-consolidation job runs on its own schedule.
Memory Consolidation Interval (ms)
Interval between memory-consolidation runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
Decay Sweep Enabled
When checked, the decay-sweep job runs on its own schedule.
Decay Sweep Interval (ms)
Interval between decay-sweep runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
Auto Improve Enabled
When checked, the auto-improve job runs on its own schedule.
Auto Improve Interval (ms)
Interval between auto-improve runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
Observation Bridge Enabled
When checked, the observation-bridge job runs on its own schedule.
Observation Bridge Interval (ms)
Interval between observation-bridge runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
Checkpoint Purge Enabled
When checked, the checkpoint-purge job runs on its own schedule.
Checkpoint Purge Interval (ms)
Interval between checkpoint-purge runs, in milliseconds. Minimum 60000.
